in_game_description: Asteroids are divided into different classes, which are visible after scanning. Ore cores are only found in the Class A variety and are the precious essence of asteroids.
mechanics_text: The final 'e' of the ore names 'Doxtrite' and 'Orichalzine' is removed in naming the corresponding core.
1t Doxtrit Core is required for the Icarus Heavy AS blueprint (5t on Android).
